question: Write and CI-test an actual local file acceptance checker without acquiring or inspecting any actual halo_info file in this stage. It must require an existing exact c000 ph000 z0.950 halo_info_NNN.asdf, supplied manifest checksums.crc32 GNU POSIX cksum+file byte count, full computed local SHA256, pinned official ASDF Blosc extension, and real file header fields matching previously SHA-locked source-copy exact values. Never label provider provenance authenticated from a user-supplied manifest or assert individual M200c.

scope.allowed_now: Only frozen copied header JSON, source code and tiny self-created bytes in temporary directory for cksum/sha/parser negative tests. NO actual Abacus file/Globus/API transfer in current CI. Optional future user-initiated --real-file runs only when genuine file and checksum have independently been acquired and verified in a new data-access decision. This checker NEVER authenticates provenance of user-supplied checksums.crc32 without independent provider record.
scope.file_path_pattern: AbacusSummit_base_c000_ph000/halos/z0.950/halo_info/halo_info_XXX.asdf where XXX exactly 3 digits, not invented NNN and no symlink
scope.checksum_requirement: GNU/POSIX cksum CRC AND byte length in supplied checksums.crc32 exactly one record with exact filename or ./filename; independently compute local SHA256; no zlib crc32 equivalence.
scope.header_requirement: read af.tree['header'] from existing ASDF file via upstream SHA-pinned Blosc extension and ASDF lazy_load; exact SimName, Redshift, ScaleFactor, OmegaNow_m, SODensityL1, ParticleMassHMsun and ParticleMassMsun matching archived copied state with prereg tol 1e-10 absolute for z/a, and 2e-7 relative for scalar mass/SO/Omega; do not load halo columns or N
scope.test_negative: missing supplied checksum, duplicate entry, checksum/byte count corruption, path redshift mismatch, symlink, wrong simulation identity, wrong source copy or observed odd unseal all fail-closed
